DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どうされましたか。お話を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: What has happened? Please tell me about it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 知らない人から「口座の確認を手伝う」と電話があり、アプリを入れるように言われました。不安で来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 相手の指示と現在の状態を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: A stranger called saying they would help check my bank account and told me to install an app. I was worried, so I came here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain the caller's instructions and the current situation. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: アプリを入れた後、開いたり、相手に番号を伝えたりしましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: After installing the app, did you open it or give the caller any numbers?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 入れただけです。まだ開いていませんし、画面を見せる操作や番号の連絡もしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 起動も接続もしていないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I only installed it. I have not opened it, shared my screen or sent them any numbers.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you have neither launched the app nor connected it. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その状態を担当者へお伝えください。相手から今も連絡はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please tell the staff member that. Are they still contacting you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: メッセージで操作を急がされています。今は返事をせず、これ以上進めたくありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 追加操作を止めたいと申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: They are sending messages urging me to operate it. I am not replying now, and I do not want to go any further.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to stop any additional operations. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当窓口につなぎます。電話の時刻、相手の番号、メッセージの画面があれば持っていてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will connect you with the responsible desk. Please keep the call time, the caller's number and any message screens you have.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 着信履歴とメッセージは残っています。アプリの名前もメモして、相談時に見せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 相談に持参する記録を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I still have the call history and messages. I will also note the app's name and show them during the consultation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm which records to bring to the consultation. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。調査や端末の対応は、担当者が状態を確認してご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. The staff member will check the situation and explain the investigation and what to do about your device.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 自分でアプリを開いて確かめず、相手にも返信せず、このまま担当の方に説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 相手へ返信せず担当窓口に進む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will not open the app to check it myself or reply to them. I will explain the situation as it is to the staff member.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Proceed to the responsible desk without replying to the caller. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 分かりました。こちらの相談席へどうぞ。担当者をお呼びします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please come to this consultation seat. I will call the staff member.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 送り状の宛先は、こちらの販売店でよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this retailer the correct addressee on the shipping label?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: いいえ。母へ商品を贈ります。このラベルは箱に入っていたので、使えると思って貼りました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家族への贈り物で同封ラベルを使った理由を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: No. I am sending the item as a gift to my mother. This label was inside the box, so I thought I could use it and attached it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that it is a gift for family and why you used the enclosed label. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 見出しに返品用とありますね。販売店へ戻すためのラベルではないでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: The heading says it is for returns. Isn't this a label for sending it back to the retailer?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 返品はしません。母の住所はラベルにありませんでした。箱に付いていた物なら宛先も自動で変わると思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 返品しないと伝え既存ラベルが新宛先に変わると思ったと訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I am not returning it. My mother's address was not on the label. I thought a label that came with the box would automatically change to the destination.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you are not returning it and correct your assumption that the existing label would change to the new address. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今回の送り先を記入する必要があります。まだこのラベルでは受け付けていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: You need to enter the destination for this shipment. We have not accepted it using this label yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 古いラベルを外して、母の住所を書いた新しい送り状を使いたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 返品ラベルを外して家族宛ての新送り状へ替えると頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I would like to remove the old label and use a new shipping label with my mother's address.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to remove the return label and replace it with a new shipping label addressed to your family member. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 古い宛先やコードが残らないよう、外側の状態も確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let's also check the outside of the box so no old address or code remains.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 返送用の控えも貼らず、別に保管します。母へ届くための物と混ぜないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 返送用の控えも箱へ貼らず別保管すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will keep the return slip separately instead of attaching that too. I will avoid mixing it with the materials for delivery to my mother.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will also keep the return slip separately instead of attaching it to the box. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 新しい送り状ができましたら、箱と一緒にお見せください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Once the new shipping label is ready, please show it to us together with the box.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 母の住所と名前を書き、案内と照合しました。外側に販売店宛てのラベルは残っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 新しい宛先を照合し旧ラベルが外側に残っていないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I wrote my mother's name and address and checked them against the instructions. No label addressed to the retailer remains on the outside.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm you checked the new address and that no old label remains outside. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確認します。今回はお母様宛ての発送として、送り状と箱の状態を拝見します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will check. We will inspect the shipping label and the box for this shipment to your mother.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 振込先の情報を確認されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you checking the bank transfer recipient's details?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。この数字を口座番号の欄に入れたいのですが、ハイフンが二つあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 入力する番号が口座番号か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I want to enter this number in the account number field, but it has two hyphens.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the number you are entering is an account number. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その数字は、請求書の「お問い合わせ」の欄にありますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: That number is in the invoice's inquiries section, isn't it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: そうでした。電話番号を口座番号だと思っていました。振込先は別の欄を探す必要がありますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 問い合わせ欄の数字を読んだと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: You're right. I mistook the telephone number for the account number. I need to look in a different section for the transfer details.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you read the number in the inquiries section. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 下の「お支払い先」の欄に、銀行名や支店名が載っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: The payment recipient section below lists the bank and branch names.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ありました。ただ、口座番号の最後の数字が印刷でつぶれていて読めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 振込先欄を探す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I found it. But the final digit of the account number is blurred in the printing, so I cannot read it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Find the transfer recipient section. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 読めない数字を推測して入力せず、請求元に確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please check with the issuer rather than guessing an illegible digit and entering it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 請求元へ、振込先の番号をもう一度送ってもらいます。今日は入力を途中で止めたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 不鮮明な番号を請求元に確認すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will ask the issuer to send the recipient's account number again. I want to stop entering the information for today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Decide to check the unclear number with the issuer. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。機械の入力を取り消して、明細をお持ち帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Please cancel the entry on the machine and take the statement home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 取り消しました。銀行名、支店名、口座番号、名義が読める状態になってから振り込みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 判読できる情報がそろうまで送金を待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I cancelled it. I will make the transfer once I can read the bank name, branch name, account number and account holder's name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Wait to send the money until all the details are legible. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。今回は送金されていません。情報がそろいましたら改めてお手続きください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. No transfer has been made this time. Please carry out the procedure again when you have all the information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 一つあります。ただ、瓶が二本とパン、冷凍食品があるので、一緒に入れるとパンがつぶれそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 持参袋の数を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have one. But I have two bottles, bread and frozen food, so I am afraid the bread will get squashed if they all go together.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say how many bags you brought. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 追加の袋を一枚ご用意できます。この袋は五円です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: We can provide one extra bag. This bag costs five yen.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 五円の袋を一枚お願いします。重い瓶は持参した丈夫な袋に入れたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 五円の袋を一枚頼み、重い瓶は持参した丈夫な袋に入れたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: One five-yen bag, please. I would like the heavy bottles in the sturdy bag I brought.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask for one five-yen bag and say you want to put the heavy bottles in the sturdy bag you brought. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: かしこまりました。パンと冷凍食品は、追加の袋でよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Certainly. Shall I put the bread and frozen food in the extra bag?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 冷凍食品がパンに直接触れないように分けたいので、持参袋には瓶と冷凍食品を入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 冷凍食品がパンに直接触れないよう、瓶と冷凍食品は持参袋に入れると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I want to keep the frozen food from touching the bread directly, so I will put the bottles and frozen food in my own bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will put the bottles and frozen food in your own bag so the frozen food does not touch the bread directly. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: それでは、パンをこちらの軽い袋に入れます。冷凍食品用の保冷バッグはお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Then I will put the bread in this light bag. Do you have an insulated bag for the frozen food?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日は持っていません。寄り道せずに帰ります。保冷用の用品の売り場も教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 保冷バッグはないので寄り道せず帰ると伝え、保冷用品の売り場を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I do not have one today. I will go straight home. Please also tell me where the cooling supplies are sold.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you have no insulated bag and will go straight home, then ask where cooling supplies are sold. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: サービスカウンターの横です。必要でしたら、会計後にご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Beside the service counter. Please have a look after paying if you need them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。瓶と冷凍食品はこちら、パンは追加袋ですね。帰る前に保冷用品を見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 冷凍品の帰宅までの扱いを自分で決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. The bottles and frozen food go here, and the bread in the extra bag, right? I will look at the cooling supplies before going home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide how you will handle the frozen items until you get home. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、その二袋でお渡しします。追加の袋代を含めた金額でお会計をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, we will hand them to you in those two bags. Please pay the total including the extra bag charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 園内の地図をご覧になりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to look at a map of the park?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。母と一周するつもりでしたが、母が日なたでは疲れやすいと言っています。木陰を多く歩きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同行者の希望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I was planning a full circuit with my mother, but she says she tires easily in the sun. We would like to walk mostly in the shade of trees.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain your companion's preference. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この長い周回は、半分ほどが広場沿いの日なたになります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: About half of this long circuit runs in the sun along the open square.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: それなら一周はやめます。木陰を通って、短く戻れる道はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 一周するのはやめ、木陰を通って短く戻れる道があるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Then we will not do a full circuit. Is there a short route through the shade that brings us back?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Decide against the full circuit and ask for a shorter route through the shade that returns here. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 入口から林の手前のベンチまでなら、木陰の道で往復できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can walk out and back along a shaded path from the entrance to the bench just before the woods.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ベンチで休んでから、遠い出口に回らず、今の入口へ戻れますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 短い別経路を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: We can rest on the bench and return to the entrance we used, without going around to the distant exit, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose a different, shorter route. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。同じ道を戻ります。ベンチから入口までは、地図の短い区間です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. You return along the same path. The bench-to-entrance stretch is the short section on the map.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: そこまでにします。母が途中で疲れたら、ベンチまで行かずに引き返します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: ベンチまでにすると決め、母が途中で疲れたらベンチまで行かず引き返すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: We will only go that far. If my mother tires on the way, we will turn back without reaching the bench.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Decide to go no farther than the bench and say you will turn back before reaching it if your mother gets tired on the way. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その時の様子に合わせてください。今の入口は、この地図の「現在地」です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please adjust to how she feels at the time. The entrance you used is marked as your current location on this map.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 現在地から木陰の道を往復し、休むとしても林の手前まで。長い周回には入りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 現在地から木陰の道を往復し、遠くても林の手前までで、長い周回には入らないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: We will go out and back along the shaded path from the current location, and even if we rest, we will go no farther than just before the woods. We will not take the long circuit.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm you will take the shaded path out and back from here, go no farther than before the woods, and avoid the long circuit. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、短い経路はこちらです。地図をお持ちになり、無理のない範囲でお歩きください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11202-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, here is the short route. Please take the map and walk only as far as is comfortable.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 列車は現在、出発を見合わせています。お急ぎでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: The train's departure is currently suspended. Are you in a hurry?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 到着駅で父が車で待っています。表示の「十時二十分」は、向こうに着く時刻ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 待ち合わせに影響する遅れを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: My father is waiting in his car at the destination station. Is the displayed 10:20 the time we arrive there?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain how the delay affects your meeting. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: それは、この駅の出発予定時刻です。現在は、その時刻を過ぎて見合わせています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: That is the scheduled departure time from this station. It has now passed, and departures are still suspended.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 到着時刻ではなかったんですね。今、何時に着くか分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 出発見込みと到着見込みを区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: So it was not the arrival time. Do you know now what time we will arrive?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish the expected departure from the expected arrival. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: まだ確定していません。運転が再開してから、案内を更新します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: It has not been confirmed yet. We will update the information after services resume.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では、父には元の到着時刻のまま待ってもらわず、出発も到着も未定だと伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 父を元の到着時刻のまま待たせず、出発も到着も未定だと連絡すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I will tell my father that both departure and arrival are undecided, instead of having him wait according to the original arrival time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will tell your father that both departure and arrival are undecided rather than have him wait based on the original arrival time. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。再開の案内は、この掲示板と放送でお知らせします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. We will announce the resumption of services on this noticeboard and over the public address system.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 一度連絡して、父には駅前でずっと待たずにいてもらいます。次の更新もここで確認できますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 家族へ現状だけ連絡すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will contact him now so he does not keep waiting outside the station. I can check the next update here too, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Decide to tell your family only the current situation. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらで確認できます。席を離れる場合も、放送が聞こえる待合室をご利用ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can check it here. If you leave your seat, please use the waiting room where you can hear the announcements.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 連絡できました。待合室で待ち、運転再開の案内が出たら到着の見込みをもう一度伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 父に連絡できたと報告し、待合室で待ち、運転再開の案内後に到着見込みを改めて伝えると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have contacted him. I will wait in the waiting room and tell him the expected arrival again when services are announced to resume.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Report that you reached your father, and say you will wait in the waiting room and update him on the expected arrival after the resumption of service is announced. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。更新があり次第お知らせしますので、待合室でお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will let you know as soon as there is an update, so please wait in the waiting room.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 相談のご予約ですね。ご自身の相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like a consultation appointment. Is the consultation for you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 弟の生活相談です。私は今日来られましたが、相談するのは弟です。代わりに日時を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 本人の代わりに予約を相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: It is a consultation about my younger brother's living situation. I could come today, but he is the one who needs the consultation. I would like to ask about appointment times on his behalf.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you are asking about an appointment on the person's behalf. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 当日はご本人が参加できる日時を選んでください。付き添いについても、受付時に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please choose a time when he can attend in person. We will also check about accompaniment when taking the booking.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 私は平日午前が空いていますが、弟はその時間に働いています。夕方の枠はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 自分は平日午前が空いているが弟は勤務中だと説明し、夕方の相談枠があるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I am free on weekday mornings, but my brother works then. Do you have any late-afternoon slots?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you are free on weekday mornings but your younger brother works then, and ask whether there are late-afternoon consultation slots. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 来週の木曜日、午後四時の枠が一つあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: There is one slot at four in the afternoon next Thursday.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 弟は四時まで仕事なので間に合いません。勤務の調整ができるか、弟に確認してから申し込みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人の勤務時間を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: My brother works until four, so he cannot make it. I will check whether he can adjust his work schedule before applying.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain the person's working hours. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 分かりました。その間、枠を仮に押さえる制度はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Understood. We do not have a system for temporarily holding the slot while you check.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では、空きが残るとは限らないですね。弟と確認した後、どこへ連絡すればいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 空きが残るとは限らないと確認し、弟と相談した後の連絡先を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then it may no longer be available. Where should I contact after checking with my brother?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm that the slot may no longer be available, and ask whom to contact after checking with your younger brother. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この相談受付の番号へお願いします。連絡時に、参加できる日時をいくつかお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please call this consultation reception number. When you call, give several times when he can attend.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 本人が参加できる候補を二つか三つ聞いて、その番号へ連絡します。今は予約を確定しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 弟が参加できる日時を二つか三つ確認して連絡し、今は予約を確定しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will ask him for two or three times he can attend and call that number. I will not confirm an appointment now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will ask your younger brother for two or three times he can attend and call back, without confirming a booking now. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。本日は空き状況と受付番号のご案内までです。ご本人と確認後にご連絡ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes. Today we are only providing availability and the reception number. Please contact us after checking with him.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お会計は済みましたか。お帰りの前に確認したいことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Have you finished paying? Is there anything you want to check before leaving?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい、支払いは済みました。でも、この預かり証がまだ手元にあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 会計済みであることを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes, I have paid. But I still have this safekeeping receipt with me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you have already paid. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: これは検査室でお預かりした私物の受取証ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: This is the claim ticket for personal belongings held in the examination room, isn't it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: そうです。検査の前に時計を外して預けました。領収書と同じ紙だと思い、しまいかけました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 検査前に時計を預けたことと、預かり証を領収書と同じだと思いしまいかけたことを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I took off my watch and left it there before the examination. I thought this was the same as the payment receipt and almost put it away.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you left your watch before the examination and almost put away the claim slip because you mistook it for the payment receipt. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 領収書とは別です。時計は検査室の受付でお返しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: It is separate from the payment receipt. Your watch will be returned at the examination room reception.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: もう一度、検査室の受付へ行けばいいですか。何を見せれば受け取れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 検査室の受付へ戻ればよいか確認し、時計を受け取るために何を見せるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Should I go back to the examination room reception? What do I need to show to collect it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm whether you should return to the examination-room reception and ask what to show to collect your watch. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この預かり証を見せ、お名前を伝えてください。担当者が記録と照合します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Show this claim ticket and give your name. The staff member will check it against the records.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。帰る前に時計を受け取ります。預かり証を領収書とは別に手に持って行きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 帰る前に時計を受け取り、預かり証を領収書とは別に持って行くと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I will collect my watch before leaving. I will carry the claim ticket in my hand, separate from the payment receipt.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will collect your watch before leaving and carry the claim slip separately from the payment receipt. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。お品物を受け取る時にも、ご自身の時計かお確かめください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. When collecting it, please also make sure it is your own watch.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 証明の番号だけで終わらせず、時計の形とベルトも確認してから受け取ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 私物を受け取ってから帰ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will not stop at checking just the ticket number. I will also check the watch's shape and strap before accepting it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will collect your belongings before leaving. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: そのようにお願いします。検査室の受付は、奥の廊下を右へ進んだ所です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please do so. The examination room reception is down the corridor at the back, to the right.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 何をなくされましたか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 銀色の鍵を二本、緑の輪でまとめた物です。今朝、家でないことに気付きました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 紛失品の特徴を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Two silver keys held together by a green ring. I noticed they were missing at home this morning.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Describe the lost item's features. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 家の中でなくされたのでしょうか。最後に使った場所は覚えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Did you lose them inside your home? Do you remember where you last used them?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 昨日の夕方、駅の駐輪場で自転車の鍵を使いました。その時には二本ともありました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 昨日夕方に駅の駐輪場で自転車の鍵を使い、その時は二本ともあったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I used my bicycle key in the station bicycle parking area yesterday evening. I had both keys then.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you used the bicycle key at the station bicycle parking area yesterday evening and still had both keys then. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その後、どこを通りましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Where did you go after that?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 駐輪場から自転車でスーパーへ寄り、それから家へ帰りました。途中で鍵を見た記憶はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 駐輪場から自転車でスーパーに寄って帰宅し、途中で鍵を見た記憶はないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I rode from the bicycle parking area to the supermarket, then went home. I do not remember seeing the keys on the way.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you cycled from the bicycle parking area to the supermarket and then home, and do not remember seeing the keys along the way. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: では、気付いた場所はご自宅ですが、なくした場所はまだ分からないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: So you noticed at home, but do not yet know where you lost them, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。家で気付いたからといって、家で落としたとは言えません。駐輪場からスーパーまでの経路も書きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 家で気付いても家で落としたとは断定できないと述べ、駐輪場からスーパーまでの経路も書きたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. Noticing at home does not mean I can say I dropped them there. I would like to record the route from the bicycle parking area to the supermarket too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that noticing the loss at home does not establish that you dropped the keys there, and that you also want to record the route from bicycle parking to the supermarket. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その順で伺います。スーパーの店名と、立ち寄った時刻を分かる範囲でお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will take the details in that order. Please tell me the supermarket's name and when you visited, as far as you know.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 店名はこちらです。時刻は六時ごろです。最後に使ったのは駐輪場、その後にスーパー、今朝家で気付いた、と届けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 落とした場所を断定せず届ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Here is the store's name. It was around six. I will report that I last used them at the bicycle parking area, then visited the supermarket, and noticed at home this morning.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Report the loss without asserting where you dropped the item. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。場所を一か所に限定せず、その経過と鍵の特徴で受け付けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will accept the report with that sequence of events and the keys' features, without limiting it to one location.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 不在票をお持ちですね。宛名の方はお客様でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have a missed-delivery notice. Are you the person it is addressed to?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: いいえ。以前一緒に住んでいた友人です。今は別の住所に住んでいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 自分宛てではないことを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: No. It is for a friend I used to live with. They now live at another address.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that it is not addressed to you. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 現在は同居されていないのですね。代理で受け取りたいというご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: So you do not currently live together. Are you asking to collect it on their behalf?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。でも、同じ住所だったのは以前のことなので、そのまま家族扱いにはできないと思い、確認に来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 現在の同居関係を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. But we shared an address only in the past, so I thought I could not simply be treated as family and came to check.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain your current living relationship. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 代理受取の条件を、配達物の種類とあわせて確認します。まず不在票を拝見します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will check the conditions for collection by a representative along with the type of delivery. First, may I see the missed-delivery notice?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。友人には、差出人と宛先が旧住所になっているかも確認してもらいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 友人に差出人と、宛先が旧住所のままかを確認してもらいたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. I also want my friend to check with the sender and check whether the destination is the old address.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you want your friend to check the sender and whether the destination still shows the old address. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらの配達物では、本人の手続きについて担当からご案内します。お客様だけでは今、受け取れません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: For this delivery, the staff member will explain the procedure the addressee must carry out. You cannot collect it on your own now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。本人が連絡する先を教えてください。私が代わりに受取サインをするのはやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本人が連絡する窓口を尋ね、自分が代理で受取サインをするのはやめると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. Please tell me whom my friend should contact. I will not sign for receipt on their behalf.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask whom the addressee should contact and say you will not sign for receipt on their behalf. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この連絡先を本人へお伝えください。転送や受取方法は、担当へ直接ご相談いただきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please give them this contact information. They should consult the responsible staff directly about forwarding or how to receive it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 友人に不在票の内容と連絡先を伝えます。今日は受け取らず、本人の確認を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 確認前に受け取り済みにしないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will tell my friend the contents of the notice and the contact details. I will not collect it today and will wait for them to check.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will not mark it as received before checking. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。不在票をお返しします。本人から担当窓口へご連絡いただくようお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11206-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Here is the missed-delivery notice back. Please ask the addressee to contact the responsible desk.
